import sys
import time
import M5
assert '/m5-live-0d183218da2a43fe89c5c512fdcdfe33' in sys.path, "MicroPython VM was reset"
M5.begin()
screen = M5.Display
screen.setBrightness(255)
screen.fillScreen(16777215)
screen.setTextSize(2)
screen.setTextColor(0, 16777215)
from unit import PIRUnit
unit = PIRUnit((1, 2))
print("LIVE_A_READY")
previous = None
while True:
 M5.update()
 value = int(unit.get_status())
 if value != previous:
  print("LIVE_A_PIR", value)
  screen.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 80, 16777215)
  screen.setCursor(4, 4)
  screen.print("RUN A")
  screen.setCursor(4, 32)
  screen.print("PIR " + str(value))
  previous = value
 time.sleep_ms(25)
